data-analytics-agents.name: Data, Analytics & AI Agents (Default: 3 Data + 2 Analytics + 2 Agents + P1)
data-analytics-agents.description: End-to-end Google Cloud Data, Analytics & AI Agents platforms covering Data Products, consumer authorization, governance/security, BI/ML consumption, FinOps, and ADK/Gemini Enterprise agent grounding & AgentOps.

domains.name: Data Platform Foundation, Ingestion & Data Products
domains.keywords: Medallion architecture (`Bronze` / `Silver` / `Gold`), Data Product classification & contracts, batch/streaming ingestion (`Dataflow`, `Pub/Sub`, `DTS`), ELT pipelines (`Dataform`, `dbt`, `Managed Spark`), GCP Project Factory & Terraform IaC
domains.summary_focus: Medallion architecture (`Bronze`/`Silver`/`Gold`), Data Product classification & contracts, ingestion/ELT pipelines, Project Factory & IaC

domains.name: Data Sharing, Consumer Authorization & Access Management
domains.keywords: Consumer application & user authorization models, least-privilege view-level access (`Authorized Views` / `Authorized Datasets`), stable semantic interface datasets, `BigQuery Sharing (Analytics Hub)`, approval workflows & IAM scale quotas
domains.summary_focus: Consumer application authorization, Authorized Views/Datasets, semantic interface datasets, Analytics Hub & IAM scale quotas

domains.name: Data Governance, Knowledge Catalog, Quality & Security
domains.keywords: `Dataplex Universal Catalog` (Knowledge Catalog Data Products, business glossary, aspect types, `Data Lineage`), automated Data Quality & profiling scans, banking/enterprise compliance, `Cloud DLP`, BigQuery Column-Level Security (`Policy Tags` / Dynamic Masking), Row-Level Security (`RLS`), CMEK & `VPC-SC`
domains.summary_focus: Dataplex Universal Catalog, Data Quality & lineage, Cloud DLP, Column-Level Security (`Policy Tags`), Row-Level Security (`RLS`) & VPC-SC

domains.name: Analytics Consumption, Semantic Layer, BI & Applied ML
domains.keywords: Enterprise BI & governed semantic layer (`Looker`, `Conversational Analytics`), analytical SQL patterns, `BigQuery ML` (`BQML`), Python/Spark analytics (`BigFrames`, notebooks), unstructured & graph analytics (`BigLake`, `BigQuery Graph`)
domains.summary_focus: Governed BI & semantic layer (`Looker`, `Conversational Analytics`), analytical SQL, `BQML`, `BigFrames`, `BigLake` & `BigQuery Graph`

domains.name: Platform Observability, Capacity Optimization & FinOps
domains.keywords: `BigQuery Editions` slot reservations & autoscaling, physical/logical storage & partitioning/clustering optimization, centralized `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` & Cloud Logging telemetry, and producer vs. consumer compute cost attribution
domains.summary_focus: `BigQuery Editions` slot reservations & autoscaling, storage/query optimization, `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` telemetry & cost attribution

domains.name: AI Agents Architecture, Orchestration & Data Grounding
domains.keywords: Agentic design & multi-agent orchestration (`Google ADK`, `Gemini Enterprise`), grounding agents on governed Data Products (`Google Cloud MCP`, `BigQuery Data Agents`, `Data Agent Kit`, Vector Search/RAG), and end-to-end identity passthrough (`OAuth On-Behalf-Of` -> `SESSION_USER()`)
domains.summary_focus: `Google ADK`, `Gemini Enterprise`, grounding over Data Products (`MCP`, `BigQuery Data Agents`, `DAK`, RAG) & OAuth `On-Behalf-Of` identity

domains.name: AgentOps, Evaluation, Security Guardrails & AI FinOps
domains.keywords: Agent evaluation datasets & quality metrics (`ADK Eval`, `Vertex AI Evaluation`), agent tracing & telemetry (`Cloud Trace`, `Cloud Logging`), prompt/tool security guardrails (`Model Armor`, IAM tool boundaries), and combined LLM token + BigQuery slot FinOps guardrails
domains.summary_focus: Agent evaluation (`ADK Eval`, `Vertex AI Evaluation`), trace observability, `Model Armor` guardrails & token/slot FinOps

domains.name: Project Organization, Workstream Alignment & Delivery Governance
domains.keywords: Engagement roadmap & milestone prioritization, workshop cadence & session preparation, cross-workstream alignment across Data, Analytics & Agents, and PoC/pilot handoff logistics
domains.summary_focus: Roadmap prioritization, workshop cadence, cross-workstream alignment across Data, Analytics & Agents, and pilot logistics

agentic-ai-platform.name: Agentic AI, Conversational Analytics & MCP Grounding Platform
agentic-ai-platform.description: AI-first engagements focused on Google ADK, Gemini Enterprise, BigQuery Data Agents, MCP tool servers, structured/unstructured grounding, OAuth On-Behalf-Of security, and production AgentOps.

domains.name: Agentic Use Cases, Persona Journeys & Multi-Agent Orchestration
domains.keywords: Agentic architecture patterns (`Google ADK`, `Gemini Enterprise`), single-agent vs. multi-agent orchestration, session memory & state management, human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows, and user experience integration
domains.summary_focus: `Google ADK` & `Gemini Enterprise` orchestration, multi-agent topologies, session memory & human-in-the-loop patterns

domains.name: Structured Data Grounding, Semantic Layer & Conversational Analytics
domains.keywords: `BigQuery Data Agents`, `Conversational Analytics API`, `Data Agent Kit (DAK)`, `Looker` semantic layer grounding, context enrichment (`Dataplex` metadata, verified SQL templates, golden queries), and high-accuracy NL2SQL
domains.summary_focus: `BigQuery Data Agents`, `Conversational Analytics`, `Looker` semantic layer, context enrichment & NL2SQL accuracy

domains.name: Unstructured Knowledge, Vector Search (RAG) & Graph Grounding
domains.keywords: `BigLake` object tables, document parsing & chunking pipelines, `Vertex AI Vector Search` & `BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH` embeddings, hybrid relational + `BigQuery Property Graph` (`GQL`) retrieval, and citation grounding
domains.summary_focus: Unstructured document chunking, `Vertex AI` / `BigQuery` vector search (RAG), and `BigQuery Property Graph` hybrid retrieval

domains.name: MCP Tool Servers, External API Integration & Action Execution
domains.keywords: Model Context Protocol (`MCP`) servers (`Google Cloud MCP`, `MCP Toolbox for Databases`), custom ADK function tools, `Apigee` / external ERP & CRM API connectors, transactional write-back safety, and idempotency
domains.summary_focus: `MCP` servers (`Google Cloud MCP`, `MCP Toolbox`), custom ADK tools, external API integration & transactional safety

domains.name: Identity Propagation (`OAuth On-Behalf-Of`), IAM, RLS/CLS & Model Armor
domains.keywords: End-to-end user identity propagation (`OAuth 2.0 On-Behalf-Of` -> `SESSION_USER()`), BigQuery Row-Level Security (`RLS`) & Column-Level Security (`Policy Tags` / Dynamic Masking), `Model Armor` prompt injection/DLP shields, and VPC-SC perimeters
domains.summary_focus: `OAuth On-Behalf-Of` identity passthrough (`SESSION_USER()`), BigQuery `RLS`/`CLS`, `Model Armor` prompt shields & VPC-SC

domains.name: Agent Evaluation (`ADK Eval`), Observability & Quality Benchmarking
domains.keywords: Golden evaluation datasets, trajectory & tool-call accuracy metrics (`ADK Eval`, `Vertex AI GenAI Evaluation`), OpenTelemetry / `Cloud Trace` distributed tracing, conversation logging, and continuous regression testing
domains.summary_focus: Golden evaluation datasets, trajectory & response benchmarking (`ADK Eval`), `Cloud Trace` telemetry & CI/CD regression gates

domains.name: Runtime Deployment (`Agent Engine` / `Cloud Run`), Latency & Token/Slot FinOps
domains.keywords: `Vertex AI Agent Engine` & `Cloud Run` production hosting, context caching, model routing (`Gemini Flash` vs. `Pro`), latency SLOs, BigQuery `maximum_bytes_billed` dry-run guards, and combined LLM token + BigQuery slot FinOps
domains.summary_focus: `Vertex AI Agent Engine` / `Cloud Run` deployment, latency tuning, model routing & combined LLM token + BigQuery slot FinOps

domains.name: Project Organization, Workstream Alignment & Delivery Governance
domains.keywords: Engagement roadmap & milestone prioritization, workshop cadence & review slot scheduling, cross-workstream scope alignment, golden dataset/schema handoff logistics & unblocking workarounds
domains.summary_focus: Roadmap prioritization, workshop cadence, cross-workstream alignment, and golden dataset/schema handoff logistics
